description: Marko Kaasik at the University of Tartu publishes the 2018–2021 observations from the Valgjärve mast in Estonia. Zenodo identifies FMP Network Tartu01 and supplies a RAR archive free under CC BY 4.0. Institutional documentation establishes the installation as a wind-measurement site used for wind-energy assessment and atmospheric-model evaluation. These observations can help constrain local wind-resource assumptions and model variability. The earlier period is separately drafted as data-valgjarve-wind-mast-observations-2015-2018. Coverage is site-specific and does not establish a continuous national monitoring product. Although the installation documentation describes high-frequency measurements at several heights, the public archive metadata do not establish which channels, sampling intervals or quality-control flags this release contains. The shared year 2018 creates a possible overlap with the earlier archive. No files were downloaded, timestamps reconciled or measurement accuracy independently checked; those limitations should be resolved before calibration.
